source: 808 Return
target: 808 Reditus

source: Not far from the abandoned neighborhood, Albus Medici, who had parted ways with Gusain, walked along the shadows by the roadside toward the cemetery.
target: Non procul ā regione relicta, Albus Medici, quī a Gusain sē discesserat, iuxta viam per umbrās ad coemeterium ambulāvit.

source: Suddenly, he stopped, as if sensing an undercurrent in the nearby darkness.
target: Subitō consēdit, quāsi latentem motum in proxiam tēnebrīs perceptūrus esset.

source: Albus chuckled, and a dense fog immediately surged out, covering his figure and half the street.
target: Albus subrīdit, et dēns nebula statim exorta est, figuram eius ēt dimidiem viā tegens.

source: After several seconds, the fog gradually dispersed, but Albus was no longer there.
target: Pōst nōnnūllōs secundōs, nebula pāulatim evanuit, sed Albus iam nōn aderat.

source: He had vanished.
target: Evanuerat.

source: From the shadow that had just been enveloped by the fog, Julie, with her hair tied up and wearing a slit dress, emerged, staring at the spot where Albus had stood for several seconds.
target: Ex umbrā, quāmodo modo nebula involverat, Julia, capillīs colligātīs et vestī scintillātā (densim “veste scissa” indūtā), emersit, locum, ūbi Albus aliquot secundīs steterat, intuēns.

source: A golden ring with a blue gemstone adorned her left middle finger.
target: Anulus aureus cum gemmā caeruleā digitum mēdium sinistrum eius ornābat.

source: Julie looked away, her expression somewhat grim, and headed toward the few blocks where the exiles gathered.
target: Julia occulōs avertit, vultū paulō tristi, et ad pauca quadra, ūbi exsulēs congregābantur, accessit.

source: Some time later, in the deep darkness of the night, the sharp, painful screams of a man echoed from a room.
target: Aliquando postea, in profunda noctis tēnēbrīs, acūtī et dolorōsī hominis clāmorēs ex conclāvī resonāvērunt.

source: Lumian returned to the full-length mirror in his room and stepped out, lying down on the bed.
target: Lumian ad speculum integrāe statūrae in cellā suā rediit et exiit, in lectō iacēns.

source: After discovering that Julie had quietly left the Carnivore bar, he knew the Demoness had been secretly following him and Gusain.
target: Pōstquam dētexit Juliam tacitō tabernam Carnivōrum deseruisse, intellexit daemonissam eum et Gusain furtim secūtam fuisse.

source: This was one of his intended outcomes.
target: Hoc ūnum ex eventibus dēstīnātīs eius erat.

source: Otherwise, he wouldn’t have discussed searching for Albus Medici and accepting the corresponding test with Gusain at the bar.
target: Alioquīn, de quāerendō Album Medicum et probatione cōrrēspondentī cum Gusain in tabernā non locūtus fuisset.

source: He had done it to ensure that Julie, temporarily acting as a bartender, would hear it!
target: Id fēcisset ut Julia, pro tempore ut tabernāria fungēns, id audīret!

source: Although he and Gusain had lowered their voices, the Demoness was close enough to catch the crucial information with her enhanced hearing.
target: Quamquam ille et Gusain vocēs demiserant, daemonissa tamen satis prope erat ut informationem clāvicam, auditū acerrimō praeditā, capere possēt.

source: Of course, Lumian hadn’t initially considered Julie as a contingency plan because Gusain had witnessed the Demoness castrate Vijepan and had clearly noticed her beauty and charm when she became a bartender.
target: Certe, Lumian initiō quī Juliam nōn ut cōnsilium subsitutīvum cōnsiderāverat, quōnam Gusain vidisset daemonissam Vijepan castrāre et palam eius pulchritūdem ac venūstātem animādvertere, quum tabernāria facta esset.

source: In such a situation, Gusain would likely guess Julie’s identity as a Demoness and remain cautious, knowing she might have overheard their conversation.
target: In talī condiciōne, Gusain verisimiliter identitātem Juliae ut daemonissam coniectūrus esset et cautus mansisset, sciēns eam sermonem eōrum fortasse audīvisse.

source: Lumian’s primary goal was to gauge the progress of the Demoness Sect regarding 0-01 based on Julie’s reaction.
target: Prīncipālem propositum Luminī erat progressum Sēctae Daemonissārum dē 0-01 ex rēactiōne Juliae aestimāre.

source: If the Demoness Sect, through the long‑term investigation of Celeste and other Demonesses, had completed preparations and was only waiting for the final opportunity to act, Julie would avoid creating extra trouble and patiently maintain the status quo.
target: Sī Sēcta Daemonissārum, per diuturnam indāgātiōnem Celeste et alīārum daemonissārum, praeparātiōnēs confecerat et sōlum ultimam occasionem agendī exspectābat, Julia iniuriam superflūam creare evitāret et statu quō patienter maneret.

source: In that case, Lumian would have to closely monitor Julie and Celeste to prevent them from taking the lead.
target: In talī cāsu, Lumian dīligenter Juliam et Celeste observāre debuisset, ne praeponderāre lācēret ībīs.

source: If the Demoness Sect wasn’t confident and still lacked information, Julie would likely use this opportunity to gather more intelligence from Gusain and the rebels connected to him, making her actions more comprehensive.
target: Sī Sēcta Daemonissārum nōn confīdēns esset et adhūc notītiā dēfērret, Julia verisimiliter hanc occasionem ad plūra indicia ex Gusain et rebellibus coniunctīs colligendā utebātur, atque actūs suos magis comprehensīvē efficīret.

source: Lumian wouldn’t need to be as urgent and could allocate time and effort to other investigations.
target: Lumian nōn tam festināns esse debuisset et tempus atque operam ad alias indāgātiōnēs tribuere potuisset.

source: In this regard, he had perfectly achieved his goal.
target: Hoc mōdō, propositum suum perfecte attigerat.

source: Now, Lumian was more curious about Julie’s reaction after discovering Albus Medici while following him and Gusain.
target: Nunc, Lumian magis curiōsus erat dē rēactiōne Juliae, pūst quum Album Medicum dētexisset, dum eum et Gusain sequerētur.

source: What would she try to do?
target: Quid facere conābitur?

source: Will she attempt an assassination on the spot, wait patiently to challenge Albus alone after he and Gusain part ways, or go find Celeste to discuss it first?
target: Num in locō statim caedem conābitur, patienter exspectābit ut postquam ille et Gusain sē diviserint, Album sōlū provocet, an prīmum Celestem quaeret ut rēm disputet?

source: It’s a pity I don’t know where they’ll encounter each other, so I can’t observe the battle and see what cards they hold.
target: Heu, pro dōlō, nescio ūbi invicem occurrant; itaque proelium spectāre et vīdēre quae chartae teneantur nōn possum.

source: If I’m lucky, I might even eliminate them both if they end up badly injured… Lumian sighed regretfully on the bed.
target: Sī fēlīx sim, fortasse utrumque perdere possim, sī graviter laesī erunt… Lumian in lectō maere suspīrat.

source: After a while, he sensed some movement from Julie’s room.
target: Pōst aliquod tempus, aliquid motūs ex cubiclō Juliae sensit.

source: The Demoness had returned.
target: Daemonissa rediit.

source: Lumian sniffed the air and detected a faint smell of blood.
target: Lumian āerem olfactus est et levem sanguinis odoris vestigiō deprehendit.

source: He chuckled inwardly and mocked, “Albus, did you lose your prized possession? I wonder if you can regrow it as an Iron‑blooded Knight…”
target: Interius subrīdens irriduit: “Albus, amisistine praetiosum bonum tuum? Miror an iterum crescere possis ut Eques Ferri‑sanguineus…”

source: There wasn’t much commotion in Morora just now, not like there was a fierce battle…
target: In Morora nunc nōn multum strepitus erat, neque sicut in proeliō acerbo…

source: So, did Julie fail to locate Albus and vent her frustration on some random guy?
target: Ergo, num Julia Album dētegere defecerat et īram suam in aliquem fortuitum hominem efferre conāta est?

source: Lumian waited patiently, ensuring the City of Exiles, Morora, fell into a deep slumber, then transformed into a shadow creature and blended into the darkness of the room.
target: Lumian patienter exspectāvit, curāns ut Urbs Exsulōrum, Morora, in profundum somnum caderet, dēinde in creatūram umbrātam sē converteret et in tēnēbrīs conclāvi sē celāvisset.

source: He moved swiftly, returning to the abandoned neighborhood with the volcano, and arrived at the crack in the basement, once again gazing into the void filled with dense fog.
target: Celeriter sē movit, vulcānō comitante, rediens ad regionem relictam, et ad fissūram in cellā subterraneā pervenit, iterum in vanitātem dēnsae nebulae intūreō.

source: He felt it was necessary to investigate this area thoroughly to better understand some details in the 0-01 sealing information and gain further insight into the underground mausoleum.
target: Sēnsit oportēre hanc regionem diligenter explorāre, ut singulā dē informatione sigillandī 0-01 melius intellēgeret atque ulterīōres rēs de mausoleō subterraneō cognoscere posset.

source: Neither Gusain nor Albus would expect him to return here, especially after the possibility of facing Julie’s attack!
target: Nec Gusain nec Albus exspectābant eum hic redīre, praesertim post opportunitātem adversus Juliae impetum!

source: The fog isn’t as dense as before.
target: Nebula nōn tam dēnsa est quam anteā.

source: The visibility range is about thirteen or fourteen meters…
target: Ambitus visibilitātis est circiter trēdecim aut quattuordecim metra…

source: Was it Albus and Gusain enhancing the fog of war with their abilities or items earlier?
target: Num ante Albus et Gusain facultātibus aut instrumentīs nebula bellī auxērunt?

source: Lumian observed the fog for a few seconds, making a preliminary judgment.
target: Lumian per aliquot secundōs nebulam contemplātus est, iudiciōnem prēliminārem faciēns.

source: He then conjured a bright white fireball for illumination and slowly walked into the fog of war.
target: Deinde globum ignis candidī radiante ad illuminātionem evocāvit et lente in nebulam bellī ingressus est.

source: The fog felt similar to before, with no other changes.
target: Nebula eādem videbātur ac anteā, sīn ūlla altera mūtātiō.

source: Lumian dripped a few drops of perfume on the ground every so often to mark his path for the return journey.
target: Lumian paucas guttās unguentī in terram interdum stillāvit, ut viam reditūs signāret.

source: He was heading to the area marked with statues on the map Gusain had shown.
target: Ad regionem in charta a Gusain ostensā, ubi statuae notae erant, sē dīrigebat.

source: In the dead silence, only the faint sound of footsteps echoed in the fog as Lumian discerned the terrain, passing several iron puppets hidden in the fog.
target: In mortuā silentiā, sōlum tenuis sonus vestigiōrum per nebulam resonābat, dum Lumian terram discerneret, complūrēs automāta ferrea in nebulā abscondīta trānsībat.

source: Finally, relying on his Hunter abilities and the memorized map, he reached his destination.
target: Denique, innīxus artibus venātiōnis et chartā memorātā, ad dēstinātum locum pervenit.

source: There, against the rock wall, stood four statues made of gray‑white stone, each over two meters tall.
target: Ibi, contra parietem sāxium, quattuor statuae ex lapidē cinereo‑albo, quarum ūnaquaeque plus quam duo metra alta erat, stabant.

source: These statues faced each other in pairs, their faces blurred, dressed in peculiar clothing, with square scarves wrapped around their heads.
target: Hae statuae in paria sē invicem collocāvērunt, vultūs eōrum obscurī, indūtæ vestīmentīs inīsitīs, cum pallīs quadrātīs circumscrips capitum.

source: In the middle of the statues stood a half‑height stone platform with an unlit oil lamp on it.
target: In mediō statuarum stābat tabulātum lapideum dimidiō altitudinis, super quod face olearia nōn accensa recubābat.

source: Who made these statues?
target: Quis has statuas fēcit?

source: They weren’t originally here.
target: Nōn initiō hic erant.

source: According to the 0‑01 sealing information, this place isn’t part of the underground mausoleum, it’s just normal underground…
target: Secūndum informationēs dē sigillo 0‑01, hic locus nōn est pars mausoleī subterraneī, sed sōlum subterranus ordinārius est…

source: After the volcanic eruption, some of the mausoleum’s power leaked out, and someone built these four statues and placed the oil lamp here.
target: Post eruptionem vulcanicā, quaedam potentia mausoleī effusa est, atque aliquis has quattuor statuas condidit et face olearia hic posuit.

source: What’s the purpose?
target: Quid est propositum?

source: Lumian mused silently, staring at the bright white fireball.
target: Lumian tacitē meditātus est, globum ignis candidī radiante fīxo oculīs intuitus.

source: Judging by the style of the statues and the overall arrangement, he doubted the Church of Knowledge had set them up to reinforce the seal.
target: Ex genere statuarum et dīspositiōne ordinātā, dubitābat Ecclesiam Scientiae ēās constituisse ad sigillum corroborandum.

source: It was more likely the work of the Iron and Blood Cross Order, which explained Gusain’s familiarity with the area.
target: Probabilius erat opus Ordinis Crucis Ferri et Sanguinis, quod explicābat magnam familiaritātem Gusain cum regione.

source: Meanwhile, Lumian felt the call from underground growing stronger.
target: Interim, Lumian sensit vocem ex subterrāneo firmiōrem fīrī.

source: It seemed to be just behind the rock wall, waiting for him to approach.
target: Videbātur esse iūstō post parietem sāxium, eum appropinquāre exspectāns.

source: Lumian took a deep breath, suppressing his inner urge.
target: Lumian altē inspirāvit, internum impetum reprimēns.

source: He circled the statues and the oil lamp on the stone platform several times, finding nothing unusual.
target: Statuās et face oleariam in tabulātō lapideō compluriē circumvagātus est, nihil insolitum invēnīens.

source: Lumian pondered for a moment and had two ideas.
target: Lumian paulō meditātus est et dūās cōgitiōnēs habuit.

source: One was to light the oil lamp and see what happened; the other was to take this opportunity to destroy something and trigger a possible change.
target: Una erat face oleariam accendēre et vidēre quid evenīret; altera erat hanc occasionem capere ad aliquid dēstruendum et mutationem possibilis excitandam.

source: Lighting the oil lamp is too risky.
target: Face oleariam accendere nimis periculōsum est.

source: It’s not necessary yet…
target: Nondum necessārium est…

source: Lumian decided on the second idea after some thought.
target: Lumian, post longam meditātiōnem, secūndam idēam elegit.

source: Destruction is always easier than construction!
target: Dēstructiō semper facilius est quam constructiō!

source: And if something went wrong, leaving a mess behind would be more meaningful than keeping the place intact.
target: Et sī aliquid male evenīret, reliquās caoticas relinquere potius esset quam locum intāctum servāre.

source: Lumian conjured a bright white fireball, placing it at the base of one of the statues, setting it to explode with a delay.
target: Lumian globum ignis candidī radiante evocāvit, eum ad rādicem unīus statuae collocāns, itā condīxit ut post moram explōderet.

source: After setting up five time bombs, Lumian moved about ten meters away, hiding in the dense fog, and snapped his fingers.
target: Postquam quīnque bombāe temporālēs posuerat, Lumian circiter decem metra abiit, in nebulā dēnsa sē celāns, et digitōs strinxit.

source: Rumble!
target: Tumultus!

source: The four statues and the stone platform simultaneously underwent a violent explosion, cracking from the base and collapsing into piles of rubble.
target: Quattuor statuae et tabulātum lapideum simul violenti explosiōnī subiectī sunt, rādice fissī et in acervōs ruinārum corruērunt.

source: The explosion dissipated some of the dense fog, allowing Lumian to see the statues and the platform.
target: Explosiō quaedam nebula dēnsam dissipāvit, quae Lumianī permisit statuae et tabulātum vidēre.

source: No anomalies or dangers appeared…
target: Nolla insolīta aut pericula apparuērunt…

source: Good.
target: Bene.

source: Now, let’s see if Gusain or Albus notice the commotion and come to check it out.
target: Nunc vidēmus, utrum Gusain vel Albus tumultum animadverterint et ad rem explorandam accedant.

source: I’ll be hiding here, ready to strike a fatal blow…
target: Hīc latitābō, parātus ictum mortiferum inferre…

source: Lumian grew more puzzled about the statues and the platform, planning to set a simple trap for Gusain that might be overlooked due to its subtlety.
target: Lumian de statuae et tabulātō magis perplexus fātus est, cōnspicuum dolum simplex pro Gusain parandō prōponens, quī ob eius subtilitātem fortasse neglexisset.

source: If the statues and the platform were crucial, Gusain would rush to confirm the situation, instinctively thinking the destroyer had already escaped to avoid an ambush.
target: Sī statuae et tabulātum essent essentialia, Gusain festināre ad rem comprobandam accēdere dūxelit, instintīvē putāns destructorem iam effugisse ut insidiam vitāret.

source: Just as Lumian was about to retreat further into the fog, he noticed the five piles of rubble starting to wriggle.
target: Iā dum Lumian in nebulā ulteriōrem recēdere parāret, quīnque catervās ruinārum incipiēntēs quassārī animadvertere vīdī.

source: They collided and quickly reformed, rising back into their original statue and platform shapes.
target: Confligerunt et celeriter reformātae sunt, redīre in formas origināriās statuarum et tabulātī.

source: Identical to before.
target: Idem erant, sicut anteā.

source: Wh– Lumian’s eyes froze.
target: Heu— oculī Luminī congelāvērunt.

source: The stone statues and the platform can restore themselves?
target: Statuae lapideae et tabulātum sē restituere possunt?

source: No wonder the Iron and Blood Cross Order didn’t station guards here…
target: Non mirum est quōd Ordinis Crucis Ferri et Sanguīnīs hic custōdēs nōn constituit!

source: They aren’t afraid of these things being destroyed!
target: Nōn timent nē haec deleantur!

source: Lumian quickly recovered and tried a new approach.
target: Lumian celeriter sē recorporāvit et ad novum modum accessit.

source: This time, after blowing up the statues and the platform, he used his Traveler’s Bag to collect some of the rubble, waiting a few meters away.
target: Hoc tempore, postquam statuae et tabulātum evellit, sacculus viātōris ad aliquot ruinās colligendās ūsus est, pauca metra distantem exspectāns.

source: The stone statues and the platform restored themselves again, drawing materials from the earth, while the rubble in Lumian’s pouch became ordinary stones.
target: Statuae lapideae et tabulātum iterum sē restituere coeperunt, materiās ex terrā trahentēs, dum ruināe in sacculō Luminī in lapidēs commūnēs mutātae sunt.

source: Lumian temporarily gave up on destruction, emptied the pouch of rubble, and returned to the statues, picking up the oil lamp with the glass cover.
target: Lumian ad dēstructiōnem temporāriē cessāvit, sacculus ruinārum exsiccāvit, et ad statuae rediit, face oleariam cum operculō vitreo sumens.

source: Inside the lamp was a semi‑solid, semi‑liquid yellowish grease, with a wick seemingly woven from black hair.
target: Intra facem oleariam inveniebātur substantia pallide luteo‑rubra, semi‑solida et semi‑liquida, cum stoppinō denso nigrō in summō, quasi ex capillīs confectō.

source: The more Lumian looked at it, the more familiar it seemed.
target: Quō magis Lumian eam contemplābat, eo magis nota apparebat.

source: He began to recall the source of this familiarity.
target: Coepit originem huius familiaritātis recordārī.

source: After over ten seconds, he suddenly reached into his Traveler’s Bag and took out an item.
target: Post plūsquam decem secundīs, subitō in sacculum viātōris manum intulit et rēm extrāxit.

source: It was a pale yellowish‑red, semi‑solid substance in a transparent glass bottle, with a thick black wick on top.
target: Erat substantia pallide luteo‑rubra, semi‑solida, in vitro translucīdō, cum stoppinō denso nigrō in summō.

source: Corpse wax candle!
target: Candēla ex cera cadāverum!

source: A candle made from the corpse oils of an Iron‑blooded Knight and a Demoness of Despair mixed with other substances!
target: Candēla ex oleīs cadāverum Equitis Ferri‑sanguineī et daemonissae Desperātiōnis, cum aliīs substantiīs mixta!

source: The oil lamp on the stone platform resembled it somewhat.
target: Face olearia in tabulātō lapideō aliquantulum huic similis videbātur.

source: Lumian muttered to himself, “Magician, Magician, –” said that Fourth Epoch Trier and a place in Bansy Harbor were the best scenes for the corpse wax candle…
target: Lumian sībi murmurāvit, “Magus, Magus,” inquit, “Quartum Saeculum Trier et locus in Portū Bansy sunt optima loca pro candēla ex cera cadāverum.”

source: What about the underground mausoleum in Morora, which is very similar to Fourth Epoch Trier?
target: Quid dē mausoleō subterraneō in Morora, quod valdē simile est Quārtō Saeculō Trier?
